pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Customer Prior History Before Stating Past Interactions
lesson.when: A customer mentions past interactions or requests a previously discussed item, but no verified source or tool result provides their history or product details.
lesson.do: State uncertainty regarding the previous record and ask the customer to clarify their desired item.
lesson.otherwise: Do not assert specific past choices, product details, or prices from memory or unverified context.
